title: [tenmin-range-reply-dust] tenMinRangePrefix: characterization test for the storage prefix of a calendar range
body:
Target: PeaceG03/PeaceSTOCKS

add a characterization test for tenMinRangePrefix in src/tenmin-range-reply-dust.ts: range prefix
- tenMinRangePrefix("2026-01-01", "2026-01-31") is "permanent/tenmin-reply-dust/2026-01-01_2026-01-31"
- tenMinRangePrefix("2026-01-01", "2026-01-01") is "permanent/tenmin-reply-dust/2026-01-01_2026-01-01"
- tenMinRangePrefix("2026-02-01", "2026-01-01") throws INVALID_RANGE

(Builder pre-file, TEST_CASE_EXISTING, public-test-case-existing-v1): Peace's task (source: peace). The range storage prefix (and the INVALID_RANGE ordering guard) has no test; this pins its current behaviour. Production safety: test-only: one new src/*.test.ts file only: no source edits, no fix commit. Job B grades it fix-free: the test passes on the current code and fails with the function body stubbed. The running scanner chain is unchanged. A box dry-run on PeaceSTOCKS 47cfaaf built exactly one candidate (public-test-case-existing-v1); a local Job B run graded it COUNTS (the new test passes on the current code and fails with tenMinRangePrefix stubbed); suite 556/556 with all six new tests of this batch, all 4 typechecks ok.
